items.title: How much review time actually catches more issues?
items.description: The 45-minute review from this unit's scenario caught almost nothing real, buried under naming comments. But more time isn't a straight line to more issues caught, either — a longer, more complex doc has more real issues to find, and each extra minute of review finds fewer new ones than the last. Drag the review time slider and see where it starts to flatten out for an 18-page doc like the one in this unit.
items.compute: const maxIssues = 2 + docPages * 0.6; const decay = 8 + docPages * 1.1; const issuesCaught = maxIssues * (1 - Math.exp(-reviewMinutes / decay)); return { issuesCaught };
